title: רבא בר תחליפא

paragraphs: Rava bar Tahlifa said that R' Yirmeyah bar Abba said: Hullin 45b, 49a. In Rav's name: Shabbat 120b; this needs examination. She'erit Yosef brings him among Rav's pupils because he spoke in Rav's name, but it seems to me it should read Rava. See Huna bar Tahlifa, R' Yonah bar Tahlifa, and R' Menashya bar Tahlifa: it appears all were in Rava's time. Heilprin also places Tahlifa, Rav Huna’s father, before Rava. The checked passages report teachings in Rava’s name. Yet I saw Rav Anan bar Tahlifa before Shmuel; this needs examination. Rava bar Tahlifa spoke to Ravina. Rav Shemaya objected, and they went to ask Rava (Eruvin 40a). See above, Abba bar Tahlifa; perhaps they are one.
